title: Senior Level Designer
description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.

 

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

 

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada.


Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration


\n
$115,000 - $149,500 a year

title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.
  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.
  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.
  • Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:
  • Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.


\n
$90,000 - $120,000 a year
\n

The anticipated annual salary range for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. For remote-based positions, this range may vary based on your local market. Full-time employment positions will also be eligible to receive pre-IPO equity and annual bonus, in addition to competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, 401(k) plan, life and accidental death and disability coverage, and parental leave benefits. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

 

Who we are

 

We are driven by a passion for science and compassion for patients. We act with urgency to ensure our treatments are one day accessible to all who need them.

 

We live by our core values of passion, courage, and integrity. Excellence in our work means the chance to unlock a better quality of life for our patients, and with that comes tremendous responsibility.

 

We innovate on a path that hasnât been paved. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and take calculated risks to achieve our mission. We arenât afraid to ask âwhy notâ and challenge the status quo.

 

We maintain a start-up culture of camaraderie and leadership by example, regardless of title.

 

Weâre proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that celebrating our differences creates stronger, lasting solutions that better serve our team, our patients and their healthcare providers.

 

Notice to staffing firms

 

Orca Bio does not accept resumes from staffing agencies with which we do not have a written agreement and specific engagement for a particular opening. Our employment activities, inquiries and offers are managed through our HR/Talent team, and all candidates are presented through this channel only. We do not accept unsolicited resumes, and we rarely outsource recruitment.

title: Team Lead Education
description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

  • Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

  • Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

title: Solutions Delivery Manager
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

Weâre building an AI scientist for our customers. We canât do that if we havenât built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Solutions Delivery Manager is responsible for ensuring Benchling solution development, coverage, efficacy, quality, and enablement across the Customer Experience team. Operating at the intersection of our product suite and our customers, this dynamic role focuses on translating our product capabilities into effective solutions to match our customers' scientific use cases, and enabling the broader CX organization to operationalize around Benchling's best practices. Solutions Delivery Manager works cross-functionally with Benchling's build organization, as well as across the CX departments, to develop robust solutions that can deliver value to our customers, while improving internal knowledge and productivity.

Chemistry is one of Benchling's newest and most exciting product areas â unlocking an entirely new group of companies, scientists, and science to be done on Benchling. This role will help navigate a budding product area through to market adoption, partnering closely with internal product, enablement, and delivery teams, while working directly with customers to build trust and help shape our vision in this space.

Successful Solutions Delivery Managers will harness the knowledge and experience Benchling has gained across thousands of customer engagements, and leverage previous and learned experience to serve as an expert across scientific domains and modalities served by Benchling. They will develop, and continuously improve our solutions as both the science and Benchling product capabilities evolve. A successful candidate will be comfortable working across teams and systems, often with no existing guidance or playbook, to deliver impactful solutions and value aligned with our department and team goals.

Â 

RESPONSIBILITIES

Including, but not limited to:

  • Navigate a budding product area through to market adoption â partnering with internal product, enablement, and delivery teams, while working directly with customers to build trust and shape our vision in this space

  • Serve as a key advisor on customer accounts as an expert in the scientific and product space

  • Deliver services and oversee services engagements to ensure high quality solution and delivery

  • Build a roadmap of solution assets to deliver impactful solutions to the broader CX organization

  • Build and maintain solution assets, such as best practices documents

  • Train and educate the broader CX organization through various means (e.g. create documentation, drive enablement initiatives, refresh solutions, advise on customer engagements, etc.)

  • Collaborate across CX departments to reflect customer learnings into solution assets

  • Operationalize Benchlingâs new product introduction motions to deliver new product insights

  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Strategy teams to align on product value and customer messaging

  • Learn existing and new verticals that Benchling services

Â 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Scientific and Benchling Knowledge

    • Fluency in medicinal chemistry or PD chemistry, ideally both

    • Fluency in a chemistry-focused lab informatics tool

    • Knowledge of Benchlingâs Platform and solutions, and technical proficiency with Benchling products is preferred

  • Customer Readiness

    • Experienced customer experience professional with a strong track record in overseeing the success of customer engagements

    • Superior customer service skills â the ability to be empathetic, accurate, resourceful, and conscientious with a sense of urgency

  • Problem Solving and Collaborative Success

    • Excellent oral and written communication skills to work effectively with others both inside and outside departmental boundaries, at remote locations and/or outside the company

    • Demonstrate ability to analyze and resolve complex problems and rapidly assimilate new knowledge and information

    • Flexible and able to adjust on the fly to new demands; a high sense of urgency, tendency towards action, and comfortable working through ambiguity to independently make progress on individual and team goals

  • Experience and Educational Requirements

    • 6+ years of lab experience in medicinal chemistry, PD chemistry, or a closely related field

    • 2+ years experience in customer service or customer-facing roles

    • Bachelor's degree in chemistry, or life sciences related field is required (biology, microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, neurology, etc.)

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

Als Franchise Partner gewinnen Sie KMU-Inhaber (5-10 Klienten) als langfristige Mentoring-Mandate. Die Zusammenarbeit läuft über strukturierte KMU-Programme in drei Phasen:

title: Customer Success Manager (m/f/x)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to own the relationship with the customers connected to our out‑of‑home (OOH) delivery platform.

You will be the first contact for our customers. You know their numbers, and when a customer is stuck, you are the one who gets things moving inside GLS/NXT. You work at the intersection of product, engineering, data and commercial, and you are measured on customer outcomes rather than on activity.

This role is perfect for someone who likes owning results across organisational boundaries, is comfortable with data, and can hold their own with a customer's operations director in the morning and our engineering leads in the afternoon.

What you will do

  • Own customer relationships: Act as the main contact for connected customers across markets, from onboarding through to steady‑state growth

  • Drive customer performance: Own adoption and performance KPIs per customer, such as platform utilisation and integration health, and deliver measurable improvement Resolve blockers: Spot what is holding customers back and bring in the right GLS/NXT teams to solve it

  • Shape the roadmap: Turn customer requirements into prioritised roadmap input, and separate market‑specific requests from true platform needs

  • Generate insights: Use platform and operational data (Looker, BigQuery, Mixpanel) to produce insights that customers act on, and share best practices across customers and markets

  • Run a structured engagement rhythm: Lead monthly reviews and quarterly deep‑dives per customer and track the actions that come out of them

  • Build growth cases: Identify growth opportunities per market and build the business case for them

What you bring

  • Multiple years of experience in customer success, account or partner management in a B2B platform, SaaS or logistics‑tech environment

  • A track record of moving KPIs, not just maintaining relationships

  • Hands‑on with data: comfortable in Looker, Mixpanel or SQL/BigQuery, and able to turn numbers into a clear story

  • Experience with technical products and integrations, and credibility with engineers and product managers

  • Strong structuring and communication skills for business reviews, management reports and action follow‑up

  • The ability to influence teams you do not manage, across functions and countries in Fluent English, both written and spoken

Nice to have

  • German language skills

  • Experience in logistics, parcel delivery or out‑of‑home delivery

  • Familiarity with APIs or platform integrations

What we at GLS/NXT offer

  • Dynamic workplace: A digital environment with international projects and space to learn and grow.

  • Flexible work environment: Hybrid working mode with a tailored remote policy. Professional growth: A personal budget of €1,000 for learning and development initiatives. Modern workspace: Great office space in Berlin Mitte with top‑tier equipment.

  • Competitive compensation: A transparent salary package that reflects your expertise and experience.

  • Bonus system: A clear bonus model that lets you share in your own and the team's performance.

  • Engaging team culture: Monthly team cooking, regular events and offsites. Vacation: 30 days of holiday per year.

  • Referral rewards: Rewards for recommending new team members.

Even if you do not meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply if you believe you are well‑suited for the role and can contribute meaningfully to our team.

About GLS/NXT

GLS/NXT was founded with the mission to build the next generation of logistics experiences driven by technology: core, adjacent and beyond. More specifically, our sphere of interest is the logistics and eCommerce sector. We are entrepreneurs and hence always start with the user's needs. We are located between corporate and startups and leverage the benefits of both:

startup speed and corporate muscle. GLS/NXT is home to different project teams, which act as startups with business responsibility and set their own vision and mission. GLS/NXT is part of GLS IT Services GmbH.

Commitment to Diversity

GLS/NXT is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We aim to solve the most complex problems in sales engineering and work closely with customers in mapping out their ideal inbound process. You will dive into our enterprise customers processes to help deploy Atira agents with our FDEs and face their most intricate challenges. You are the go-to person inside our largest partners for anything project management and use case scoping related, and this from the point where you demo our product for the first time up until multi-annual partnership commercial negotiations.
Trust and use case insights are your two most valuable resources you get from customers and what you bring back home will directly shape our core platform in the near future - this requires a strong taste when it comes to how a software product is shaped and a strong opinion on what is needed to maximize customer satisfaction. Beyond that, our Deployment Strategists think beyond a single customer and are essential in figuring out the concrete steps to scale to our next 100 customers by accelerating onboarding processes and increasing customer satisfaction.

What you will do

Ownership, drive, structured thinking, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity and open ended problems. You take problems personally, decide in the absence of a clear roadmap, and own the outcome including the downside.

  • You independently run enterprise deployments end-to-end, from kickoff to production

  • Customers rely on you as their primary contact and trust your judgment

  • Your learnings have shaped core platform features and the playbook for the customers who come after you

title: Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Your Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a pivotal role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making.

You will design scalable, high-performance data pipelines, ensure data integrity, and drive efficient data processing across the organization. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and implement best practices that empower data-driven decision-making at scale.

This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you build what comes next. As LIQID scales beyond €4 billion in assets under management, the demands on our data infrastructure are growing fast. You will have real ownership over how we meet that challenge, with the autonomy to propose solutions and the backing to ship them.

 

What will keep you challenged?

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure efficient, secure, and reliable data processing from source systems to our data warehouse

  • Develop and manage ETL/ELT workflows to integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring seamless ingestion, transformation, and availability

  • Implement and enforce data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to guarantee accuracy and integrity for analytics and operational use cases

  • Ensure data security and compliance by applying best practices and industry standards for handling sensitive information

  • Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions that unlock new insights

  • Continuously evaluate and integrate new technologies to improve scalability, performance, and future-proof LIQID’s data infrastructure


What you bring

  • Over 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a similar data related role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python and ETL/ELT frameworks, with experience in data modelling, warehousing, and database management (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL)

  • Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and modern data pipeline tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt)

  • Solid understanding of data modelling principles to meet data governance, security, and compliance best practices and ensure safe and scalable data operations

  • FinTech experience is a plus, but a strong interest in financial services and data-driven decision-making is essential

  • Experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to speed up development and integrating them into standard workflows (code review, CI/CD), with the judgment to verify output, not just ship it.

  • Experience with data quality testing frameworks or rules-as-code approaches (e.g. dbt tests, Great Expectations) to catch issues before they hit production.

  • Experience with streaming/near-real-time pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) is a plus.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus


What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget of €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.


What happens next

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

  1. Initial Call with our Talent Partner: A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

  2. Video Interview with Head of Data: You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

  3. Technical Assessment with two Senior Team Members: A technical exchange to discuss your experience and expertise in relation to the role.

  4. In-Person Meeting: You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our CTO.


About us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

 

LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by equal opportunity laws.

description:

title: Financial Controller (w/m/d)
description:
Tangany mit Sitz in München ist ein innovatives Technologieunternehmen mit einer marktführenden B2B-Lösung für die Verwahrung digitaler Vermögenswerte (z. B. Kryptowährungen, Stablecoins und anderen tokenisierten Vermögenswerten) in Blockchain-Netzwerken. Unsere Lösung wird bereits von mehr als 50 institutionellen Kunden eingesetzt. Als lizenziertes Finanzinstitut wird die Tangany GmbH von der BaFin reguliert.

Für unser anhaltendes Wachstum suchen wir einen Financial Controller (w/m/d) zur Verstärkung unseres Teams.

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest das Controlling und die Finanzsteuerung und berichtest an das Management Board.

Das Team ist klein. Deine Expertise und dein Beitrag wirken sich unmittelbar aus: Du arbeitest mit unserer Accountant und unserer Steuerkanzlei z.B. an Themen wie Finanzbuchhaltung, Lohn und Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung; die formale Verantwortung für das Rechnungswesen liegt bei der Geschäftsleitung, Zahlungen geben wir im Vier-Augen-Prinzip frei. In diesem Rahmen bist du die Person, die weiß, wo die Zahlen stehen, warum sie dort stehen und wie sich Ergebnis, Kosten, Liquidität und Eigenmittel entwickeln werden.

Der Kern der Rolle hat zwei Seiten: die regulatorische Pflicht und eine Steuerung, mit der wir jede Finanzfrage jederzeit in wenigen Minuten beantworten können. Business Cases und Investor Reporting kommen dazu und wachsen mit dir.

Heute arbeiten wir vor allem mit DATEV Unternehmen Online und Tableau. Die Steuerung darauf baust du zu großen Teilen neu auf, gern AI-gestützt: Unser AI-Dev-Team setzt mit dir Live-Reporting, Abstimmungen und ein Finanz-Cockpit um.

Aufgaben

  • Den Jahresabschluss nach HGB und RechKredV erstellen, ergänzt um die RechZahlV-Posten für unser Zahlungsgeschäft, und die Prüfung gemeinsam mit unserer Steuerkanzlei und Abschlussprüfer durchführen.

  • Das aufsichtsrechtliche Meldewesen führen und Finanzinformationen nach gesetzlichen Vorgaben unter Begleitung des Compliance-Teams bereitstellen.

  • Regulatorische Planzahlen, etwa die Eigenmittelanforderung, aus der Bilanzplanung ableiten und in Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsleitung laufend überwachen.

  • Cashflow- und Runway-Planung führen und Finanzierungsbedarf früh sichtbar machen.

  • Liquiditäts- und Kontrahentenrisiken in das unternehmensweite Risikocontrolling einbringen und laufend überwachen.

  • Business Cases und Rentabilitätsrechnungen erstellen und Investor-Updates vorbereiten.

  • Eine Kostenstellenstruktur aufbauen, Budgets je Kostenstelle mit den Verantwortlichen festlegen, Kosten, Budgets und KPIs laufend überwachen sowie Live-Reporting und Ad-hoc-Auswertungen für Geschäftsleitung und Budgetverantwortliche bereitstellen und Plan-Ist-Abweichungen analysieren.

  • Aus der Praxiserfahrung heraus Input liefern, um Finanzprozesse, Tools und das interne Kontrollsystem gemeinsam mit unserem AI-Dev-Team auszubauen.

Wen wir suchen

  • Du bist Controller:in (idealerweise aus einem regulierten Institut) und hast Jahresabschluss und Meldewesen selbst verantwortet.

  • Abweichungen erkennst du früh: Wenn sich Eigenmittel, Liquidität oder Kosten in die falsche Richtung bewegen, liegt deine Analyse mit Optionen auf dem Tisch, solange noch Zeit zum Handeln ist.

  • Deine Forecasts halten auch Monate später, und wo sie abweichen, kannst du erklären, warum.

  • Meldefristen und Prüfungsanforderungen baust du so in die Abläufe ein, dass vor dem Stichtag keine Ad-hoc Aktion nötig ist.

  • Prüfer und Risikocontrolling nehmen deine Zahlen als Ausgangspunkt.

  • Stellt die Geschäftsleitung eine Finanzfrage, kannst du schnell und problemlos Antworten geben, weil deine Daten und Auswertungen genau dafür gebaut sind.

  • Du entscheidest auch mit unvollständigen Informationen, sagst klar, wenn etwas nicht geht, und stellst einen Prozess um, sobald er nicht mehr passt.

Qualifikation

Must-Haves

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Finanzen, Controlling oder einem verwandten Feld.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Controlling oder Rechnungswesen, idealerweise in einem regulierten Institut (nach KWG, ZAG oder MiCAR) oder in der Prüfung entsprechender Institute.

  • Eigenständig erstellte Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB, sowie Erfahrung mit Liquiditäts- und Kontrahentenrisiken sowie Risikotragfähigkeit.

  • Aufbau von Kostenstellenrechnung und Management-Reporting, sicherer Umgang mit DATEV, Excel und Google Sheets inklusive Finanzmodellen und deren Visualisierung, idealerweise mit einem BI-Tool wie Tableau.

  • Offenheit: Reporting mit AI-Werkzeugen neu aufsetzen.

  • Fließend Deutsch und Englisch (C1 oder höher).

Nice-to-Haves

  • Erfahrung mit MiCAR, etwa der Eigenmittelberechnung.

  • FP&A, Business Cases oder Investor-Reporting in einem wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Erfahrung im aufsichtsrechtlichen Meldewesen nach KWG oder ZAG.

  • Interesse an Krypto und Tokenisierung.

Benefits

Flexibilität & Work-Life-Balance:

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, dazu jeweils ein halber Tag frei an Heiligabend und Silvester, und bei Bedarf zusätzlicher unbezahlter Urlaub, um die Akkus wieder aufzuladen.

  • Zusätzlicher bezahlter Urlaub für frischgebackene Eltern.

  • Die Freiheit, von zu Hause oder in unserem schönen Büro mitten in München zu arbeiten.

  • Möglichkeit einer Workation, um auch auf Reisen zu arbeiten.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du arbeitest, wenn du am produktivsten bist.

Deine Entwicklung:

  • Es startet mit dem ersten Tag: Mit unserem auf deine Bedürfnisse zugeschnittenen Onboarding erhältst du einen strukturierten Einarbeitungsplan und Feedbackgespräche während der Probezeit (und natürlich auch danach).

  • Wir wachsen und möchten, dass du mit uns wächst! Werde zum Blockchain-Experten, tausche dich mit unserem hochmotivierten Team aus und bilde dich in individuellen Trainings weiter.

  • Regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche: Zweimal im Jahr evaluieren wir gemeinsam mit deinen Karriereweg und leiten die nächsten Schritte in die richtige Richtung ein.

Entlohnung und Zusatzleistungen

  • Ein attraktives, marktkonformes Jahresgehalt.

  • Spaß bei der Arbeit: eine Runde mit Kolleg:innen an unserer Tischtennisplatte, ein Feierabendgetränk auf unserer großartigen Dachterrasse und unsere Team-Events.

Motivierte Mitarbeitende sind der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Deshalb bieten wir dir über Hrmony flexible, digitale Benefits, die dich im Alltag unterstützen. Du erhältst ein monatliches Budget, das du nach deinen Bedürfnissen aufteilst:

  • Essenszuschuss: für Lebensmittel, Restaurants oder Lieferdienste

  • Mobilitätsbudget: z. B. für das Deutschlandticket

  • Sachbezüge: flexibel nutzbar für Streaming, Fitness, Shopping und mehr

Werde Teil unseres Teams und revolutioniere gemeinsam mit uns den traditionellen Finanzmarkt. Nutze die Chance und gestalte die Zukunft der Branche aktiv mit. Bewirb dich jetzt und sei Teil unserer innovativen Reise, um Blockchain-Technologie für jeden zugänglich zu machen.

title: TUM Project Study: Earned LinkedIn Media for Enterprise
description:
About us

Mediacharge GmbH is a Munich-based, internationally oriented marketing agency with ten years of experience in cutting-edge marketing for international enterprises. Operating in 14 languages, we combine first-tier strategic consulting with hands-on operational excellence, measured against business results.

Project description (TUM Project)

This project study explores what turns an enterprise’s own people into LinkedIn voices that measurably drive Sales, Recruiting or Employer Brand. Using Mediacharge and its enterprise clients as the case environment, it examines how earned media, meaning content published by real people rather than paid brand channels, creates business impact.

The project combines a business strategy perspective - objectives, the right people and measurable outcomes - with a content and platform perspective, focusing on talent profiles, content types, success patterns and the time it takes to build an effective voice.

Objectives of the project study

  • to classify enterprise objectives for earned LinkedIn media (Sales, Recruiting, Employer Brand),

  • to identify which talent profiles and content types work best for each objective,

  • to derive success patterns, including what it takes and how long it takes to see results,

  • to develop one strategy blueprint per objective and an impact model to measure business effect.

Main task and methodology

Students explore the topic through research, interviews and real enterprise cases (month 1), classify goals, talent profiles and success patterns (month 2), and build strategy blueprints, a final report and a pitch to Mediacharge leadership (month 3). Recommended methods include desk research, expert interviews, enterprise case analysis, benchmarking and impact modelling.

Student requirements

Students are fascinated by marketing at international enterprise scale, work analytically and build things that hold up in practice. Strong results open the door to a next conversation with Mediacharge.

Project scope and application

Preferred scope: 3 months in three phases: Explore, Analyse, Build

Number of students: 3–5

Supervision: A Mediacharge supervisor with direct input from enterprise practice; final pitch to leadership

Client access: Mediacharge enterprise clients, on request and case by case

Research budget: €2,000, released for a defined purpose agreed with the supervisor

title: Founding Recruiter (m/f/x)
description:
01 · Why this role exists

Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

Behind every megawatt hour our clients save, there are people who make it happen. RIZM helps Europe's largest industrial companies – together around 2% of Europe's total energy demand – make their energy decisions with AI. Our agent RIZMO works as a digital colleague. But the most important colleagues are the ones we haven't found yet.

That's your job. We're about 15 people today and growing fast. There is no recruiting playbook yet, no big HR department and no "that's how we've always done it". You'll write the playbook. Not as application admin, but as the person who shapes who RIZM becomes.

02 · Hi, we're Diana and Josh – we'll be working together

I'm Diana, 20, I study civil engineering in Münster and I currently run recruiting at RIZM on my own, 20 hours a week. That's not enough for what's ahead of us, which is why we're looking for you. We'll build this together, side by side in our Münster office. Josh, our co-founder & CBO, comes from statistics and risk management and will be your sparring partner whenever you need one – for tricky candidates, for offers and for figuring out who we need next. Got questions before you apply? Just message me on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/diana-pashaian-1637133b2/

03 · What you'll do

  • Build the team of tomorrow: Design our recruiting from scratch – roles, workflows, tools – and later bring more recruiters and sourcers on board yourself.

  • Find the right people: Track down engineers, energy experts and product people via LinkedIn, Juicebox, universities, communities and your own network.

  • Win people over: Lead first conversations, tell our story convincingly and make sure every candidate feels well looked after – even when it's a no.

  • Make it smart: Automate sequences, screening and reporting with AI instead of maintaining spreadsheets.

  • Steer by numbers: Always know where the funnel gets stuck – and turn the right dials.

  • Get us seen: Shape how RIZM is perceived as an employer – careers page, job ads, events, university partnerships.

04 · What you bring

  • Experience: You've worked in recruiting or talent acquisition, ideally in startups or tech, and you know how to approach technical profiles.

  • People sense: You spot potential even when it's not on the CV, and you talk to engineers as equals.

  • Tech affinity: You try out new tools, build your own workflows and enjoy making things faster.

  • Builder drive: You don't want to step into ready-made structures – you want to create them, independently, reliably and fast.

  • Background: A degree in psychology, business, HR, social sciences or similar – or a path that prepared you just as well.

  • Languages: Fluent German and English, written and spoken.

05 · What you get

  • Performance counts: Uncapped variable pay plus equity – good work is visible here and rewarded directly.

  • Real ownership: You're the first recruiter. What you build stays.

  • A network that moves you forward: Sparring, mentoring and learning with the networks of our investors Point 9 and Earlybird.

  • Once a year, we get out: A team workation with everyone, including conversations with inspiring guests like Robert Habeck, Kitty Mayo or James Vincent.

  • Stay fit: Urban Sports Club membership.

  • Münster office: You sit right next to our engineering team – the people you'll hire most – and you hear first-hand what makes a great engineer at RIZM. Recruiting thrives on short distances – the best ideas come up at the same table.

06 · How to apply

You don't need to write a classic cover letter. We don't think it tells us much about a person anymore.

Instead, picture this: a few years from now, RIZM welcomes its 100th team member. There's a celebration in the Münster office. One of the first people you ever hired stands up to say a few words.

- What's the one thing you hope they say about you?

- And what have you done so far that makes you believe they would?

A few honest sentences are enough.

title: TYPO3 Developer
description:
TYPO3 Developer
(Mensch)

Andere zählen Schafe. Du zählst TYPO3-Major-Versionen, die du schon migriert hast. Und hast Lust, die Websites großer, internationaler Unternehmen technisch zu verantworten?

Zur Übersicht

Der ultimative TYPO3-Check

Du bist bei uns richtig, wenn du…

  • … bei „Wir brauchen nur ein kleines Feld mehr im Backend“ im Kopf schon TCA, Datenbank-Migration und die drei Fluid-Templates aufklappst, die es wirklich braucht.

  • … für dein wichtigstes Werkzeug hältst. Direkt nach dem Cache-Leeren.

  • … beim Satz „Das ging in TYPO3 v7 aber noch“ freundlich lächelst und den Extension Scanner startest.

  • … sofort merkst, wenn dir die KI eine TypoScript-Lösung aus dem Jahr 2014 andreht. Und sie trotzdem jeden Tag nutzt, weil sie dich schneller macht.

  • … und dein Gewissen dir verbietet, freitags um 16 Uhr ein Major-Update auf Production zu schieben. Auch nicht „nur schnell“.

… dann gilt für uns nur noch eins: composer require netfed/du

Worum geht es?

Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Technik großer Corporate-Websites. Von der Aufwandsschätzung über Konzeption und Neuaufbau bis zu Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates. Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte auf einem sauberen technischen Fundament stehen.

Warum diese Rolle bei uns anders ist?

Wir arbeiten für namhafte Konzerne und große Mittelständler, bei denen die Website ein strategisches Aushängeschild ist. Du baust hier nicht Website Nummer 47 nach Schema F. Du triffst die technischen Entscheidungen und verantwortest die Architektur. Dabei vertrauen wir voll auf deine Erfahrung. Dazu kommen eine eigene, von uns betriebene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung und eine gelebte DevOps-Kultur, die sich am Stand der Technik orientiert.

Und was ist mit KI?

Gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Werkzeug. Du arbeitest mit KI als Sparringspartner: beim Refactoring, beim Testen, beim Dokumentieren, beim schnellen Zweitblick auf eine Migration. Die KI schlägt vor, du entscheidest. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden mit echter TYPO3-Erfahrung, der erkennt, wann ein Vorschlag gut ist und wann er Unsinn ist.

Was sind deine Aufgaben?

  • Du erstellst die technische Konzeption neu aufzubauender TYPO3-Websites.

  • Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Aspekte großer Kundenprojekte: Aufwandsschätzung, Neuaufbau, Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates.

  • Du setzt KI-Tools im Entwickleralltag ein und bringst unseren KI-Einsatz in der Entwicklung weiter voran.

  • Du dokumentierst so, dass andere weiterarbeiten können. Auch dein zukünftiges Ich.

Beratung und Support

  • Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden bei technischen Themen, zum Beispiel bei der Wahl der CMS-Architektur.

title: Senior Fraud & Risk Analyst (f/m/x)
description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.

With 50M+ platform downloads, we’re rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps players discover, and engage with games they enjoy - creating lasting value for both players and gaming studios.

As a Senior Fraud Analyst, you'll join our Fraud Analytics team as a close partner to our Fraud Analytics Team Lead - someone who can operate independently, mentor other team members, and help shape the fraud and risk agenda as the team and company scale.

You'll work cross-functionally with different teams, dig into fraud patterns across our platform, and build the processes we don't have yet. It's a highly visible, high-ownership role in a fast-growing company.

What You'll Own:

  • Strategic partnership: Partner directly with the Fraud Analytics Team Lead on strategy, ideation, and day-to-day problem solving - acting as a sounding board, ready to step in and keep things moving when needed.
  • Reporting uplift: Drive the evolution of fraud and risk reporting, turning raw data into sharp, decision-ready insights.
  • Fraud trend analysis: Hunt down patterns across our user base, shape the detection logic and rules that keep us ahead of bad actors, monitor how those rules perform, and optimise them over time.
  • Process ownership: Own the design of fraud and risk processes end-to-end, spotting gaps and building what doesn't exist yet.
  • Experimentation: Test, learn, and iterate - running A/B tests to continuously sharpen our fraud prevention strategies.
  • Strategic thinking: Think beyond the day-to-day, helping define where fraud and risk management goes next as the team scales.
  • Mentorship & collaboration: Mentor teammates and partner cross-functionally with Tech, Data, Product, Support, and Finance - becoming a go-to person others rely on.

What You Bring

  • Fraud & risk experience: 5+ years in fraud, risk management, or a closely related financial risk function; direct fraud experience is a strong plus, ideally in gaming or another B2C/app-based industry.
  • Data & AI fluency: Comfort working with data - SQL, databases, and hands-on experience using AI tools for analysis and prompting.
  • Analytical mindset: Strong analytical skills and genuine comfort with numbers, paired with the ability to turn analysis into clear, actionable reporting.
  • Strategic contribution: Experience contributing to or developing risk/fraud strategy, not just executing existing processes — including running A/B tests to validate ideas.
  • Collaboration & mentorship: Experience mentoring or supporting colleagues, and working cross-functionally across different stakeholder perspectives.
  • Education: A relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree (Business, Finance, Accounting, Data/Mathematics, Engineering, or similar).
  • Language: Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have:

  • Background in policy design or risk governance frameworks.
  • Relevant certifications such as CFE, CFCS, CAMS, CRISC, CFA, and/or FRM.
  • Working knowledge of relevant regulatory frameworks - e.g. GDPR, PSD2/SCA, AML/KYC principles, and PCI-DSS basics where payment data is processed.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting

Smarkets is a prediction market exchange for sports and political trading, having handled over $50 billion in volume since 2010. We're upending sports betting with the fairest prices, the best technology, and a superior customer experience, powered by attracting great people and building a high-performance environment where they thrive. We're looking for an atypical candidate with strong regulated-business experience to support our growing CFTC business.

The Team

Security sits within Infrastructure and Engineering, protecting the distributed, real-time systems behind our trading engine. The team's remit spans our core products and our DCM/DCO entities, with a real regulatory dimension to the work, particularly around our CFTC-regulated business units. Alongside that regulatory scope, the focus is squarely on hands-on engineering: designing, building, and shipping the security tooling and controls that let engineering teams move fast safely.

About the Role:

This is a founding build. You'll stand up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and mature it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams to build the controls, automation, and guardrails our trading systems and regulated entities need.

What you will do:

  • Build the Foundations: Be part of a founding build, standing up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and maturing it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams.

  • Design Guardrails: Design, build, and deploy security controls and guardrails across cloud-native platforms, including AI security solutions protecting customer-facing and internal products.

  • Automate as Code: Automate security processes as code, embedding compliance and infrastructure-as-code checks into CI/CD pipelines without slowing down frequent shipping.

  • Assess & Remediate: Conduct risk audits and assessments, translating findings into practical recommendations for engineering teams, and be hands-on in implementing those recommendations.

  • Monitor & Respond: Monitor and analyse system access logs, flag anomalies, and support incident response, containment, and post-incident root cause analysis.

  • Plan for Resilience: Plan and test security backups and disaster recovery processes to keep the platform resilient.

  • Maintain Compliance: Develop and maintain security policies, standards, and controls meeting DCM/DCO requirements, and maintain evidence and documentation to support regulatory examinations and audits.

  • Partner Across Teams: Partner with business and engineering teams on solutions, translating technical work for product and engineering audiences.

  • Champion Ownership: Build a culture of security ownership among engineers, acting as a security partner rather than a gatekeeper.

Role Requirements:

  • Security Engineering Background: Hands-on experience building security engineering/DevSecOps capabilities in a cloud-native, high-growth environment, ideally financial services or exchange infrastructure.

  • Confident Communicator: Comfortable communicating security risk, controls and technical decisions verbally and in writing to external stakeholders such as auditors or regulators.

  • Regulatory Familiarity: Familiarity with CFTC system safeguards expectations, including 17 C.F.R. § 38.1051 and § 39.18 or similar regulatory requirements.

  • AppSec Foundations: Strong grasp of application security principles (OWASP Top 10, NIST) and secure SDLC practices.

  • CI/CD & Tooling: Proficiency with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CircleCI) and security tools (Snyk, Aqua, Trivy, Checkov, Twistlock, Clair).

  • Cloud & Container Security: Hands-on expertise securing AWS/Azure/GCP, Kubernetes, containers, and IaC.

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

 


We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist, Pricing to build the analytical and machine learning capability that pricing runs on, from demand modelling through to the systems that recommend price.

You won't be starting from zero. We've invested in the foundational data and infrastructure that pricing decisions depend on. What's missing is the capability on top: models the business trusts, experiments that settle pricing questions with evidence, and economics defined once so they hold consistently across Commercial, Product and the customer experience.

The arc of the role runs from measurement to prediction to prescription - understanding how demand responds to price, forecasting how it will respond, and ultimately building the models that recommend the price itself.


What You'll Do:

  • Build and own the demand and elasticity modelling capability, quantifying how price affects volume across destination, duration, data tier, and customer segment.

  • Develop machine learning models for demand forecasting and willingness-to-pay, and take them from exploration through to production with the monitoring and retraining that keeps them honest.

  • Move us from predictive to prescriptive by building the optimisation layer that turns forecasts and elasticities into recommended prices under margin, competitive and partner constraints.

  • Design and analyse pricing experiments with statistical rigour, and apply causal methods where clean randomisation isn't possible.

  • Define pricing within our data ecosystem, owning the governed definitions of price, cost and package economics that reporting, analysis and product surfaces all read from.

  • Partner with Commercial and Finance to connect pricing decisions to margin and revenue, and to size opportunities before we commit.

  • Set the analytical standard for pricing at Airalo, from what counts as evidence through to how a model or recommendation gets validated before it influences live pricing.


    • What You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years in data science, quantitative economics, or applied research, including pricing, monetisation, or marketplace economics work that demonstrably changed decisions.

  • Experience with dynamic or algorithmic pricing systems in production.

  • An advanced degree in Econometrics, Statistics, Operations Research or similar, or equivalent applied depth in demand estimation and the identification problems that make naive price-quantity regressions wrong.

  • Hands-on machine learning experience across the full lifecycle, from feature engineering and model selection through to deployment
